_comment: Pins investigated and deliberately KEPT, with the evidence. pin-fixes.json records only drops and moves, so a keep left no trace and every later audit re-flagged the same pin — PASSA Hotel Bangkok was investigated twice on 2026-09-16 for exactly this reason. An audit should treat a slug listed here as already decided and not re-flag it unless the pin itself changes.
_rule: ONLY strong evidence belongs here. A keep that rests on the 300 m 'keep (near road)' test is PROVISIONAL and must stay re-flaggable: that same weak test would have kept the Tints of Blue pin, which the owner dropped on 2026-09-16 once five independent lines showed it sat on the wrong soi. Strong means: the pin is at 0 m on the hotel's own named OSM element, or the candidate element was positively identified as a DIFFERENT building.

decided.why: The pin is at 0 m on OSM way/1224391209 'Passa Hotel Bangkok', which it was moved onto earlier the same day (batch 2026-09-16-hotel-pin-accuracy-2) from a point 690 m away on ถนนนราธิวาสราชนครินทร์. The residual disagreement is that the review's address says 63 Soi Saladaeng 2 while OSM tags the building on ซอยศาลาแดง 3 — adjacent parallel sois. That is an OSM-tagging-vs-address difference, not a misplaced pin.

At 0 m on OSM node/4460699212 'Maitria Hotel Sukhumvit 18'. Address and pin both give Sukhumvit Soi 18. It was flagged only because Tints of Blue's pin sat 21 m away; that pin was the wrong one and has been dropped.

Address and pin both give Sukhumvit Soi 18, and the pin's sub-district and district both match the address. Flagged only because Tints of Blue's pin sat 16 m away; that pin was the wrong one and has been dropped. NOTE: --corroborate finds no current same-named OSM element for this hotel, so this keep rests on address agreement rather than a 0 m element match — weaker than the others here, but the contradicting pin is gone.

At 0 m on OSM way/337660102 'The Ambiance'. Flagged because The Classroom Hotel's pin lies 28 m away, but that hotel is also at 0 m on its own element (node/3118139439), so OSM itself places the two 28 m apart. Both pins are right.

At 0 m on OSM node/3118139439 'The Classroom's Hotel'. Its address (325/81 Soi 13/4, Central Pattaya) differs from The Ambiance's (325/89 Pattayaland Soi 3) — genuinely different places that OSM maps 28 m apart.

--corroborate offered OSM way/234719441 'Lamphu Tree House' 633 m away on the weak '2 words' rule, but its tags are addr:housenumber 2, addr:street Baan Ton Lamphu, addr:subdistrict บ้านพานถม — while the review's address is '155 สะพานวันชาติ ถนนประชาธิปไตย แขวงบวรนิเวศ'. Different house number, different street, different sub-district: a same-named DIFFERENT building. Moving there would have introduced a wrong pin.
